name: @helm-protocol/ttt-mcp

tools.name: pot_generate
tools.description: Generate a cryptographic Proof of Time timestamp (draft-helmprotocol-tttps, https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-helmprotocol-tttps/). For Claude Code workflows: use eventId + prevEventId to build a causal chain. For DeFi: use txHash + chainId + poolAddress. For a spec-conformant draft-08 §3 record binding this attestation to a specific piece of content, also supply contentDigest. One of eventId, txHash, or contentDigest is required.

prevEventId.description: Previous step's eventId — links steps into a causal chain

chainId.description: EVM chain ID (DeFi, e.g. 8453 for Base)

contentDigest.description: SHA-256 digest (lowercase hex, 64 characters) of the content this record attests to. Computed by the caller — the server never sees the content itself. When supplied, and the local time synthesis meets draft-08's own requirements (>=3 independent sources, a representable error bound), the response includes a spec-conformant potRecordV08 binary record (hex-encoded) in addition to the usual potHash fields; otherwise potRecordV08Error explains why it could not be produced.

ctxId.description: draft-08 §3.3 context identifier (domain separator for the Commitment). Defaults to a fixed server value if omitted; MAY be public.

tools.name: pot_verify
tools.description: Verify a Proof of Time using its hash and integrity shards. Returns validity, mode (turbo/full), and timestamp.

potHash.description: PoT hash to verify (hex with 0x prefix)

grgShards.description: Array of hex-encoded cryptographic integrity shards

chainId.description: EVM chain ID (e.g. 84532 for Base Sepolia)

tools.name: pot_generate_v2
tools.description: Generate the draft-11 180-octet Proof-of-Time Record v2 core. TLS binding proof is computed only after a live TLS session exists.

tsTaiUs.description: TAI timestamp in microseconds as a decimal string

holderAuthData.description: 32-octet holder public key or PSK digest encoded as hex

holderAuthType.description: 0x01 Ed25519 holder key (default) or 0x02 shared secret

tools.name: pot_verify_v2
tools.description: Verify the draft-11 180-octet PoT Record v2 core. Binding-required mode fails closed in stdio because no TLS exporter session exists.

issuerPubKey.description: Raw 32-octet issuer Ed25519 public key in hex

bindingProof.description: 64-octet Ed25519 or 32-octet HMAC TLS binding proof

tools.name: pot_verify_v08
tools.description: Verify and, when configured, admit a draft-helmprotocol-tttps-08 §3 Proof-of-Time record: recomputes the Commitment and Ed25519 signature, applies configured freshness, and atomically claims client/session/nonce in Redis before admission.

potRecordV08.description: Hex-encoded 184 or 216-octet record from pot_generate's potRecordV08 field

ctxId.description: Context identifier the record was generated under. Must match what pot_generate used, or verification fails.

issuerPubKey.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte raw Ed25519 issuer public key. Defaults to this server's own key.

content.description: The payload (utf8) to check against the record's Payload Digest field, if available

clientId.description: Stable caller identity for the durable replay ledger when TTTPS_REQUIRE_REPLAY_LEDGER=1

sessionId.description: Active transport/session identifier for the durable replay ledger when TTTPS_REQUIRE_REPLAY_LEDGER=1

tools.name: pot_query
tools.description: Query Proof of Time records. Use eventId for exact lookup of a specific workflow step. Use startTime/endTime for time-range queries.

eventId.description: Exact eventId lookup — call this at workflow start to restore action history after context compression

limit.description: Max entries to return. Default: 100, max: 1000

tools.name: pot_graph
tools.description: Traverse the causal chain of workflow steps. Given an eventId, returns the full backward chain (ancestors via prevEventId) and forward chain (steps that follow). Use after context compression to reconstruct the complete workflow timeline.

eventId.description: The workflow step to start traversal from

depth.description: Max backward traversal depth. Default: 10, max: 100

tools.name: pot_stats
tools.description: Get PoT statistics: total swaps, turbo/full counts, and turbo ratio for a given period.

tools.name: pot_health
tools.description: Check PoT system health: time source status, subgraph sync, server uptime, and current mode.

tools.name: pot_checkpoint
tools.description: Create a compressed rollup checkpoint of workflow history. Call this periodically to prevent token explosion when recovering from context compression. Returns checkpointId, compressed event history, chainIntact status, and nextCheckpointHint (recommended events before next checkpoint).

fromEventId.description: Start of range by eventId (optional, use with toEventId)

toEventId.description: End of range by eventId (optional, use with fromEventId)

startTime.description: Unix ms start time (optional, default: 1h ago)

endTime.description: Unix ms end time (optional, default: now)
